title: Pvp Tiers
description: PVP Tiers is a competitive kit PvP plugin featuring 8 preset kits, a custom kit editor, casual and ranked 1v1/2v2 matchmaking with Elo rankings, duels, parties with Teams and FFA modes, and per-kit arena cloning. Built for Paper 1.21.11 with LuckPerms.
body:
PVP Tiers
Queue up. Fight. Rank up. Repeat.

Check out the server DrexPVP.minehut.gg to see the demo server of the plugin

PVP Tiers is a fully-featured competitive kit PvP plugin built for Paper 1.21.4. Drop into instant matches with balanced preset kits or craft your own custom loadout — then climb the ranks from Bronze to Champion.

Features
🎮 8 Balanced Kits
Crystal · NethPot · DiaPot · Mace · Axe · Sword · UHC · SMP — each kit comes with a carefully tuned loadout designed for competitive play.

🏆 Ranked Matchmaking
Every kit has its own Elo rating and rank tier. Win matches to climb through Bronze → Iron → Gold → Emerald → Diamond → Netherite → Champion. Your rank shows as a prefix in-game through LuckPerms.

☕ Casual Matchmaking
Just want to fight? Queue casual — no Elo on the line, same great PvP.

👥 1v1 & 2v2
Play solo or team up. Both casual and ranked modes support 1v1 and 2v2 matchmaking.

🎯 Duels
Challenge any player directly with /duel. Pick a preset kit or use a custom loadout — no queue needed.

🛠️ Custom Kit Editor
Build your own loadout from a curated list of PvP items. Choose weapons, armor, potions, blocks, and utility items. Enchant everything with allowed enchantments and save up to 9 custom kits per player.

🎉 Party System
Invite friends with /party invite, then jump into:

Teams — split into two teams, last team standing wins
FFA — free-for-all, last alive wins
Supports up to 20 players per party match
🗺️ Per-Kit Arena Cloning
Each kit has its own arena template. Every match gets a freshly cloned world — no interference between fights, clean arena every time.

📊 Stats & Leaderboards
Track your wins, losses, and win streaks per kit. Check the leaderboard with /leaderboard to see who's on top.

🤖 NPC Support
Use /queue casual <kit> or /queue ranked <kit> to plug directly into NPC plugins — let players click an NPC to instantly join a queue.

Commands
Command	Description
/kit	Open the casual queue GUI
/queue <mode> <kit>	Directly join a queue (for NPCs)
/duel <player>	Challenge a player to a duel
/rank	View your Elo and rank per kit
/stats [player]	View PvP stats
/leaderboard	View top players
/party <invite/accept/leave/queue>	Party management
/customkit	Open the custom kit editor
/spectate <player>	Spectate a match
/leave	Leave queue, match, or spectating
Requirements
Paper 1.21.4+
Java 21
Optional: LuckPerms (for ranked prefix display)
